title: Almost Sure Convergence Rates and Concentration of Stochastic Approximation and Reinforcement Learning with Markovian Noise
abstract: arXiv:2411.13711v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper establishes, to our knowledge, the first almost sure convergence rate and the first maximal concentration bound with sub-Weibull tails for general contractive stochastic approximation algorithms with Markovian noise. As a corollary, we also obtain convergence rates in $L^p$. Key to our successes is a novel discretization of the mean ODE of stochastic approximation algorithms using intervals with diminishing (instead of constant) length. Applications yield the first almost sure convergence rate for $Q$-learning without count-based learning rates and the first maximal concentration bound for off-policy temporal difference learning, both with Markovian samples.

translated_title: 马尔可夫噪声下随机逼近与强化学习的几乎必然收敛速率与集中性
translated_abstract: 据我们所知，本文首次为具有马尔可夫噪声的一般压缩随机逼近算法建立了几乎必然收敛速率以及具有亚Weibull尾部的最大集中性界。作为推论，我们还得到了 $L^p$ 中的收敛速率。我们成功的关键在于对随机逼近算法的平均常微分方程（ODE）采用了一种新颖的离散化方法，即使用长度递减（而非恒定）的区间。在应用方面，我们首次得到了无需基于计数的 learning rates 的 $Q$-学习的几乎必然收敛速率，以及离策略时序差分学习（off-policy temporal difference learning）的首个最大集中性界，两者均基于马尔可夫样本。
tldr: 本文通过一种使用长度递减区间的平均ODE新颖离散化技术，首次为带马尔可夫噪声的压缩随机逼近算法建立了几乎必然收敛速率和亚Weibull尾部的最大集中性界，并首次应用于无基于计数学习率的Q学习及离策略时序差分学习。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first almost sure convergence rates and maximal sub-Weibull concentration bounds for contractive stochastic approximation with Markovian noise, via a novel discretization of the mean ODE using intervals of diminishing length, with applications yielding the first such results for Q-learning without count-based learning rates and off-policy TD learning.
